desc: NM0824-I is an SX1302 based, compact, low-power LoRa concentrator card in a mini PCIe 52-pin form factor, with 2 × SX1250 and 1 × SX1261 radios and an onboard I2C temperature sensor. Compared with the SX1301 LoRa chip, it offers higher sensitivity, lower power consumption and a lower operating temperature. It supports SPI and USB interfaces to the host.

overview: NM0824-I is an SX1302 based, compact and low-power LoRa concentrator card with 2 × SX1250 and 1 × SX1261 radios and an onboard I2C based temperature sensor. Compared with the SX1301 LoRa chip, it offers higher sensitivity, less power consumption and a lower operating temperature.

It supports SPI based communication with the host, and an advanced fine time-stamp feature helps to identify the estimated geo-location. The card is designed for M2M and IoT applications and can be widely applied in LoRaWAN gateways, reducing technical difficulties and development time when building LoRa gateway devices.

In the mini PCIe 52-pin form factor, the card fits standard mini PCIe slots. A Cortex-M4 microcontroller provides the USB interface, and status LEDs and a U.FL antenna connector are provided on the card. Range is up to 15 km line of sight and several km in urban environments.
